## 1. Executive Summary — What Was Just Delivered

The user drove two major bodies of work in one session:

1. **"ALL IN ON THIS 3D VIEW SHIT"** — Full production hardening of `BoardViewer3DView` (the hybrid CSS 3D substrate + R3F airwires layer).
2. **Breadboard / Breadboard Lab kickoff** — Contract-compliant start on the breadboard workbench, including one concrete cross-track win.

**All items on the session todo list are now COMPLETE (green).**

### 3D View — Core Defects Eliminated
- 1794 ms click / 240 ms RAF / forced reflow violations on angle buttons and wiring toggles
- `THREE.WebGLRenderer: Context Lost` on HMR / view switches / wiring layer toggles
- `THREE.Clock` deprecation noise
- Heavy layout thrashing when R3F + CSS 3D substrate were both active

**Root cause fixes shipped:**
- Wave 1: R3F `<Canvas>` physically hoisted out of the CSS-rotated `#board-3d-scene` container (the classic "WebGL inside live CSS 3D transform" anti-pattern). Added robust `WebGLContextRecovery` listener.
- Wave 2: Direct-DOM `snapToViewAngle()` for all 7 preset view buttons + `will-change` + `contain` + transition management via ref. The heavy O(n) substrate no longer pays animated layout cost on discrete snaps.

**Result:** The hybrid is now stable and fast. Real project data + net-aware 3D airwires (Tubes + dashed Lines + per-net markers in Chain/Mesh/Star modes) render correctly with excellent performance characteristics.

### Breadboard Track — Contract-Compliant Kickoff + First Win
- Both `pp-view-breadboard` and `breadboard-lab` inspectors run clean.
- All references read in exact recommended order.
- Rich kickoff + **Enhancement Backlog v1** (5 items) written to the self-improvement-log.
- **Concrete small win delivered:** "View in 3D" button added to `BreadboardPartInspector.tsx` (the perfect tie-in between the two efforts). The prop-based button is live and ready for parent wiring (navigation + optional auto-sync of breadboard state into the hardened 3D viewer).

## Phase 2 Complete: Full Pre-Codex Page-Skill Audit (May 2026)

**This document now covers the complete handoff package.**

After finishing the 3D + Breadboard stabilization work, the user issued the following explicit directive:

> "Before i turn it over to codex, i want you to deeply, extensively, methodically, analyze each of the the views and pages..."

They then drove the audit one skill at a time by issuing the exact `/pp-view-xxx` commands in sequence. Every single one was executed using the **non-negotiable Fast Workflow** defined in the individual page skills (inspector first → references in exact contract order → deep source + ast-grep + scc analysis → provenance cross-check → UI Container Rule evaluation → durable logs + master report update).

### Deliverables Produced

- **Master Backlog Report**: `docs/FULL-APP-VIEWS-AND-PAGES-BACKLOG-REPORT.md`
  - Now contains **41 detailed, dated analysis sections** (one per requested view/page skill).
  - Every section includes: inspector output, scc metrics, UX contract evaluation, provenance gaps vs the full campaign, P0/P1/P2 recommendations, cross-references, and evidence.

- **Skill Memory**: Every `.agents/skills/pp-view-*/references/self-improvement-log.md` now contains a full dated **Fast Workflow Execution Report** with the same rigor.

- **No production code was modified** during the entire audit sweep. All work was pure discovery + documentation.

### High-Level Synthesis — What Codex Needs to Know

The audit revealed a codebase with **strong architectural bones** but **systemic gaps in enforcement** of the safety and usability contracts the team has been building:

1. **Provenance / Trust Story is Incomplete at the Gates (Highest P0)**
   - The heavy investment in 3D mechanical, exact-part verification (Component Editor), generative stamps, breadboard health, digital twin comparison, and trust receipts is **not yet visible or enforceable** at the actual points where real decisions and money are made (Validation precheck, Exports, Order PCB, Procurement, Schematic/PCB placement, Task/Kanban boards, etc.).
   - Many surfaces still show zero provenance signals. Validation (the precheck layer) currently does not block or warn on unverified generative / unexact / 3D-missing content.
   - **Codex priority**: Turn Validation + export-validation into the real provenance enforcement gate, then propagate the signals consistently through the money gates and placement canvases.

2. **UI Container Rule Violations Are Widespread**
   - Fixed heights + nested overflow + multi-pane layouts + dense side panels + long lists/viewers create scroll traps and unreachable controls on realistic laptop viewports across almost every complex surface (Schematic, Simulation, Tasks/Kanban, Chat, right sidebar overlays, Validation issue list, Vault three-pane, etc.).
   - The design system (DESIGN.md + ui/**) has the right contract and gotchas written down, but the primitives do not yet prevent the anti-patterns.

3. **Design System vs Reality Gap**
   - The Tier 1 `pp-view-uiux-design` skill owns an excellent explicit contract (quiet hardware workbench, no decorative noise, laptop-first, no nested cards, provenance UI must be visible, etc.).
   - Reality in many views still violates it. Top-bar multiplication, cards-in-cards, low-contrast on dark, tooltip-only actions, and provenance invisibility are recurring.
   - The pending proposals in that skill’s log (token audit script, mandatory screenshot regression suite for the core shell, menu overflow checklist) are now high-priority.

4. **Test Coverage Is Highly Uneven**
   - Some surfaces (Validation 62 tests, several ui components, export-validation) are strong.
   - Many important interactive surfaces (dense viewers, drag/drop boards, multi-pane browsers, provenance flows) have zero or near-zero tracked tests at the skill level.
   - Browser + visual regression checks are still the primary safety net for layout and interaction.

5. **Extraction & Dual-Path Debt Remains**
   - Schematic and PCB both show the same pattern: heavy custom canvas + tscircuit adapter still being maintained in parallel. The Architecture view called this out; it has not yet been resolved.
   - Several god files / god panels still exist (some > 1000 LOC / high CCN).

### Recommended Immediate Codex Priorities (Post-Audit)

1. **Provenance Enforcement Sprint** (highest leverage)
   - Make Validation + export precheck the real gate.
   - Add structured provenance to simulation results, task board items, Kanban tasks, schematic/PCB placement, and supply chain alerts.
   - Ensure every money-gate surface (Exports, Order PCB, Procurement) surfaces and respects TrustReceipt / ReleaseConfidence.

2. **Design System Enforcement & Laptop Polish**
   - Implement the token audit + screenshot regression suite.
   - Harden the ui primitives so the contract violations become harder to create.
   - Fix the worst laptop-viewport scroll traps (start with Simulation, Schematic, Tasks/Kanban, Vault, Validation).

3. **Test & Visual Regression Hardening**
   - Add meaningful coverage (or at least visual regression) to the high-interaction surfaces that currently have almost none.
   - Make "browser screenshot + Performance tab evidence" a non-negotiable part of any layout or interaction change.

4. **Continue the Page-Skill Discipline**
   - Any future work on a view must start with that view’s inspector + references in order.
   - Update the skill’s self-improvement-log with the same rigor used in this audit.
